purpose: Resolve every condition occurrence that the structural catalogue parser could not parse, without carrying executable source expressions into this specification.
scope: Generated-form field visibility, requiredness, read-only state, and section expansion. Independent server-side business validation is not inferred from a form dependency.

evaluation_contract.record_context: When there is no current record, evaluation returns an absent result before executing a condition. Consumers treat this as false.
evaluation_contract.truthiness: False, zero, empty text, absent values, and nonnumeric invalid numeric values are false. Nonzero numbers and nonempty text are true. Collection objects themselves are true even when empty; explicit collection-length tests distinguish empty collections.
evaluation_contract.same_type_and_value: Both type and value must match; numeric one differs from textual one and Boolean true.
evaluation_contract.coercing_value_equality: Equal-type values compare by value. When a Boolean or numeric/string pair requires conversion, Booleans become zero or one and numeric text becomes a number; empty text becomes zero. Absent values do not compare equal to numeric zero. Declared field normalization supplies the ordinary business inputs.
evaluation_contract.selection_constants: Selection labels in decision structures are fully named semantic constants. Source-value digests identify their exact original option spelling for traceability.
evaluation_contract.logical_evaluation: Conjunction and disjunction evaluate left to right and stop once the final truth is determined. Conditional property consumers use the final truth value even where the expression yields a reference or count.
evaluation_contract.optional_collection_access: Missing or empty optional collections have a false length truth value. Negating this value is true.
evaluation_contract.collection_quantifiers: Every-row on an empty collection is true. Some-row on an empty collection is false. A direct quantifier on an absent collection raises an expression error.
evaluation_contract.expression_failure: Evaluation exceptions become an invalid-dependency-expression error. They are not silently treated as permission denial or an empty collection.
evaluation_contract.visibility: False produces dependency-derived hiding. True removes that particular hiding cause; other visibility rules and permissions remain independent.
evaluation_contract.requiredness: The derived required property is one for true and zero for false in the generated form.
evaluation_contract.read_only: The derived read-only property is one for true and zero for false in the generated form.
evaluation_contract.section_expansion: For a collapsible section, true means expanded. False permits collapse unless required values are missing or the user already expanded the section.
